Executes from this bank only if MMC1 powers on in PRG mode 3 with this bank selected at $8000; after the fifth $9FFF control write (PRG mode 2) fetches continue in bank 0, so bytes $8037-$803E of this copy are a structural copy, not a separately reachable path.

regions.label: CartFooter

regions.label: Bank15_Vectors
regions.evidence: CPU vector table (NMI $85F0, RESET $8001, IRQ $8694) duplicated in every bank because MMC1 PRG mode 2 maps the switchable bank at $C000-$FFFF.
